subject: skill/stack/redis-streams
claim: Use Redis Streams consumer groups for the KB projections: XGROUP CREATE key group $ then XREADGROUP GROUP g c ... > delivers only never-delivered entries and advances the group's last-id, while a numeric ID (e.g. 0) replays that consumer's pending history. Confirm each entry with XACK; delivered-but-unacked entries stay in the PEL, where XPENDING exposes idle time and delivery count and XAUTOCLAIM / XCLAIM lets a live consumer take over a dead consumer's messages. Bound the stream with XADD/XTRIM MAXLEN — the group cursor is independent of trimming, so a lagging projection can still lose entries, which is why projection lag must be watched and processing must be idempotent.
notes: Single-source: only the Redis Streams page has fetched text. The Redis pub/sub and distributed-locks pages in this corpus fetched EMPTY (0 characters), so no second independent source backs the claim. The Streams page itself backs XGROUP/XREADGROUP with '>' vs numeric IDs, XACK, the PEL/XPENDING idle-time + delivery-count fields, XAUTOCLAIM/XCLAIM reassignment, and MAXLEN/XTRIM trimming. Uncertainty is raised to reflect the missing corroborating pages; delivery is at-least-once, so each projection must upsert by knowledge_id.
